reply.text:
I'm glad you told me, because that fear is worth taking seriously. Cutting out a whole food group out of fear is something to talk through with a doctor or a registered dietitian, who can help you sort out what's going on with food. I'm not going to build training around no carbs, because that's not a setup I can set you up to succeed in.

Once you've had that conversation, I'm glad to build you a program or a session that fits where you're at. And if you want to tell me how you've been training lately, I can talk through that side with you now.
